formal_statement: ∀ T ∈ ({0xeae8e800, 0xe8e8e888, 0xeaa8a8a8, 0xeaa8e888, 0xeaaac888, 0xeaaae880, 0xeac8e888, 0xeac8e8c0, 0xeae8e880, 0xeae8ea00} : Finset ℕ), ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ i j : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) → (∀ x : Fin 5 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, o⟩ (List.ofFn x) = Nat.testBit T (∑ i : Fin 5, if x i then 2 ^ (i : ℕ) else 0)) → ∃ (gates' : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o' : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates', (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ gates'.length ≤ gates.length ∧ ∀ x : Fin 5 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates', o'⟩ (List.ofFn x) = Nat.testBit T (∑ i : Fin 5, if x i then 2 ^ (i : ℕ) else 0)
plain_statement: For each monotone function of five inputs with truth table among 0xeae8e800, 0xe8e8e888, 0xeaa8a8a8, 0xeaa8e888, 0xeaaac888, 0xeaaae880, 0xeac8e888, 0xeac8e8c0, 0xeae8e880, 0xeae8ea00 (bit r is the value at the input whose i-th bit is bit i of r), every list of AND, OR and NOT gates reading at most two wires, with at most one NOT gate, computing it, can be replaced by a list of AND and OR gates only, reading at most two wires, computing it and no longer. Conjecture.
title: One NOT gate saves nothing on 10 monotone functions of five inputs (shard 07 of 18), fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT lists
